name: Wei Jin Lim
bio:
Wei Jin's fascination with engines began as a child, tinkering with his grandfather's old motorcycle. This passion led him to pursue mechanical engineering, eventually landing a role at a local tuning shop specializing in performance vehicles. His meticulous nature and problem-solving skills quickly made him an invaluable asset. He joined Racing Bulls five years ago, drawn to the challenge of Formula racing. 

Wei Jin's approach to machining is characterized by precision and a deep understanding of material properties. He believes in continuous improvement, constantly seeking new techniques and technologies to optimize performance. While he values tradition, he is always open to innovative solutions, making him a bridge between the old guard and the new generation of engineers within the team. He takes immense pride in knowing his meticulous work contributes directly to the car's performance.

physical.description: Wei Jin is of average height with a wiry build and intense focus in his eyes.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an impossibly fine point.
Keeps a meticulously organized toolbox, each tool in its designated spot.
Drinks a cup of teh tarik (pulled tea) at precisely 3:00 PM every afternoon.
